inputs: Four source-bound record_inputs in INPUTS.json; full saved joins only. Prior first100 and five seeds are retained, not new independent evidence.

population.opportunities: Every saved truth-overlapping alignment site; not all sequenced molecules
population.N: alignment_status=MATCHED_READ_SITE; endpoint-eligible records including eligible omitted probabilities
population.O: N with explicit score, modification a or 28871, score_kind=read_site_ML_interval, consistent integer ML 0..255
population.S: Retained O under declared selection policy
population.unit: read-site and provider construct-condition label; no verified molecule purity
population.strata: Separate 2025_DRACH/2026_all5mer releases, all constructs and both truth classes; never pool releases or rank models

A.selection: Primary midpoint p=(ML+0.5)/256; symmetric max(p,1-p)>=t. One-sided historical p>=0.9 is legal only as a labelled selected subset; all-population interpretation invalid. Non-m6A is not multiclass canonical probability.
A.interval_selection: Half-open ML [m/256,(m+1)/256). Separately count definite/possible/ambiguous retention by class. Symmetric definite when lo>=t or hi<=1-t (all at t=0.5); possible when hi>t or lo<=1-t. Midpoint is not exact latent threshold selection.
A.classification: Predict modified if p>=0.5. Risk mean I(prediction!=label); class risk, observed risk, equal-class risk and balanced accuracy. Missing class => NA, never renormalize.
A.outputs: opportunities,N,O,S,S/O,S/N; class-specific counts/coverage/Brier/risk; observed and equal-class Brier/risk; balanced accuracy; definite/possible/ambiguous counts
A.construct_weights: Fixed 1/K over all baseline constructs and 1/2 within construct classes. Any required construct-class absent => full fixed-support NA. Separately report observed pooled and pooled equal-class estimates.
A.modkit: Reuse actual saved default/no-confidence multiclass results with own definitions, no new modkit run or binary/multiclass metric merge

B.comparisons: Each symmetric threshold and one-sided reference versus explicit baseline; class and construct strata only, releases separate
B.formula: delta=sum((w1+w0)/2*(L1-L0))+sum((L1+L0)/2*(w1-w0)); observed stratum proportions w, stratum observed Brier L
B.missing_strata: Disappearing baseline stratum => full decomposition UNIDENTIFIABLE; separate COMMON_SUPPORT_ONLY analysis with renormalized condition weights, excluded IDs and original mass, never replaces full-support difference
B.fixed_construct_check: Report equal construct and equal within-construct class weights against original K; no effect-selected groups
B.site_identity: Group by release/sample/run/contig/ref_pos0/strand, independently verify single label per group. Only then read Brier minus repeated site-mean Brier equals weighted population within-group variance. Mixed labels => NOT_APPLICABLE, no shortcut
B.inference: Descriptive algebra, not causal attribution or new statistic; no biological replicate, significance or monotonicity claims

C.native: Bounded exact-file source review. No reliable historical omission threshold => NOT_IDENTIFIED and stop native threshold branch. MM dot/current defaults never establish u. Ineligible alignment/base/model scope not threshold omissions
C.controlled_hiding: One demonstration on O: hide explicit intervals whose upper endpoint<=0.25. Hidden p in [0,0.25); retained records keep ML intervals. Per-class/observed/equal-class loss bounds over original O must contain original midpoint loss. CONTROLLED_SCORE_REMOVAL, not native mechanism validation
C.loss_bounds: y0:[l*l,u*u]; y1:[(1-u)^2,(1-l)^2]. Infimum/supremum envelopes, not CIs or occupancy
C.uninformative_native: Optional [0,1] domain envelope for eligible missing scores; explicitly uninformative, never threshold-derived

D.scope: Path-independent minimal installable Python CLI, explicit input contract, self-authored fictional example, denominators/exclusions/conditional metrics, duplicate/conflict checks, isolated directory/env test. No platform
D.exit_semantics: Default completed audit may exit0 for scientific statuses; optional strict mode distinguishes rejection, insufficient information, pass and runtime failure. Existing B2/RMT code/results unchanged; shared support equal
